title: My Body, My Rules
description: Learn the difference between a good touch and a bad touch, and how to set bodily boundaries with both strangers and people you know.

scenes.text: Your body belongs to YOU. No one is allowed to touch you in a way that makes you feel uncomfortable, confused, or scared.
Let's categorize these touches. Drag the touches to the correct box.

dragItems.text: A stranger asking to sit on their lap
A doctor checking you, with your parents in the room
Someone telling you to keep a 'special secret' about touching

choices.feedbackText: Great job! A bad touch is anything that makes you uncomfortable, touches private parts, or involves keeping a secret. A safe touch leaves you feeling happy and respected.
Try again! Remember, keeping a 'secret' about touching is a huge warning sign.

scenes.text: You are at a family gathering. A distant uncle wants to give you a big hug and kiss on the cheek, but you don't feel comfortable.
What should you do? You only have 15 seconds to decide!

choices.text: Let him hug you anyway because he is family.
choices.feedbackText: You never have to hug anyone if you don't want to, even family! Your body, your rules.

choices.text: Say 'No thank you, I'd rather do a high-five.'
choices.feedbackText: Perfect! You have the right to say NO and offer a different greeting, like a high-five or a wave.

scenes.text: You confidently offer a high-five instead. Your parents smile because they taught you to set safe boundaries. Remember the 3 steps: NO, GO, and TELL a trusted adult!
